Introduction. Fenrings are aggressive creatures found in the Mountains during the night. Their appearance is distinctly werewolf-like, standing on two legs with a black fur coat. Unlike their Frost cave counterparts, Fenrings only walk on their hind-legs.

Claw. Swings their claw in a 3-meter 90-degree horizontal arc to scratch the player (85 Slash damage). This attack has a 3-second cooldown and can be used within 2.5 meters of the player. This also has a second variation where, despite the attack name, Fenrings lunge forward and bite the player; besides the animation, it's completely identical[1] to the other variant and both share a single cooldown.

Jump. Pounces on the player and swings in with both claws (95 Slash damage). This hits in a 3-meter 90-degree horizontal arc. This attack can be used every 8 seconds when within 5–9 meters of a player, meaning it's disabled while standing close to Fenrings.

Notes. • The name "Fenring" is derived from Fenrir, the same way Surtlings derive from Surt. Fenrir (sometimes spelled Fenris or Fenrisulfr, "the Fenrir/Fenris-wolf") is a giant wolf from Norse and Germanic mythology who will swallow the god Odin during Ragnarökr. He is the son of Loki.
